# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(haven)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "HRS", "Phenotype")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")

stopifnot(dir.exists(hrs_dir))

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Define Functions

## Get Data

```{r func_load}
# Stop with `message` followed by the listed values, if there are any
stop_if_any <- function(values, message, suffix = "") {
  if (length(values) > 0) {
    stop(message, paste(values, collapse = ", "), suffix)
  }
}

get_hcap_data <- function(version = c("16", "22")) {
  version <- as.character(version)
  version <- match.arg(version)
  hcap_dir <- file.path(hrs_dir, "HCAP", paste0("HC", version))
  hcap_file_dta <- file.path(hcap_dir, paste0("hc", version, "hp_r.dta"))
  hcap_file_sas <- file.path(hcap_dir, paste0("hc", version, "hp_r.sas7bdat"))

  if (file.exists(hcap_file_dta)) {
    hcap <- haven::read_dta(hcap_file_dta)
  } else if (file.exists(hcap_file_sas)) {
    hcap <- haven::read_sas(hcap_file_sas)
  } else {
    stop(
      "Could not find hc", version, "hp_r.dta",
      " or hc", version, "hp_r.sas7bdat in: ",
      hcap_dir
    )
  }

  names(hcap) <- toupper(names(hcap))

  hcap
}

get_memory_variables <- function(hcap, has_imp = TRUE, test_num = c("R1", "R2")) {
  test_num <- match.arg(test_num)
  score_names <- c(
    "WORD1_SCORE",
    "WORD_DSCORE",
    "WREC_ORG",
    "BM_IMMSCORE",
    "BM_DELSCORE",
    "LMB_IMMSCORE",
    "LMB_DELSCORE",
    "LMB_RECOSCORE"
  )
  memory_var_df <- tibble::tribble(
    ~score_name,                ~expected_min, ~expected_max,
    "cerad_immediate_trial1",   0,             10,
    "cerad_delayed",            0,             10,
    "cerad_recognition",        0,             10,
    "brave_immediate",          0,             12,
    "brave_delayed",            0,             12,
    "logical_immediate",        0,             23,
    "logical_delayed",          0,             25,
    "logical_recognition",      0,             15
  )
  memory_var_df$hcap_var <- paste0(test_num, score_names)
  needed_vars <- memory_var_df$hcap_var

  if (has_imp) {
    memory_var_df$imp_flag <- paste0(test_num, "F", score_names)
    needed_vars <- c(needed_vars, memory_var_df$imp_flag)
  } else {
    memory_var_df$imp_flag <- NA_character_
  }

  stop_if_any(
    setdiff(needed_vars, names(hcap)),
    "These expected variables are missing from HC data: "
  )

  memory_var_df
}

get_oshea_memory_variables <- function(
    hcap, has_imp = TRUE, test_num = c("R1", "R2")
) {
  test_num <- match.arg(test_num)
  score_names <- c(
    "WORD_DSCORE",
    "LMB_DELSCORE",
    "DLRC3",
    "CPDEL_SCORE",
    "BM_DELSCORE",
    "WLREC_TOTSCORE"
  )

  oshea_var_df <- tibble::tibble(
    component_name = c(
      "oshea_word_delayed",
      "oshea_logical_delayed",
      "oshea_three_word_delayed",
      "oshea_complex_praxis_delayed",
      "oshea_brave_delayed",
      "oshea_wordlist_recognition"
    ),
    hcap_var = paste0(test_num, score_names),
    # Delayed three-word recall (DLRC3) has no imputation flag in HC16.
    imp_flag_suffix = c(
      "FWORD_DSCORE",
      "FLMB_DELSCORE",
      NA_character_,
      "FCPDEL_SCORE",
      "FBM_DELSCORE",
      "FWLREC_TOTSCORE"
    )
  )

  needed_vars <- oshea_var_df$hcap_var

  if (has_imp) {
    oshea_var_df$imp_flag <- ifelse(
      is.na(oshea_var_df$imp_flag_suffix),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(test_num, oshea_var_df$imp_flag_suffix)
    )
    needed_vars <- c(needed_vars, stats::na.omit(oshea_var_df$imp_flag))
  } else {
    oshea_var_df$imp_flag <- NA_character_
  }

  oshea_var_df$imp_flag_suffix <- NULL

  stop_if_any(
    setdiff(needed_vars, names(hcap)),
    "These expected O'Shea variables are missing from HC data: "
  )

  oshea_var_df
}
```

## Get Memory Score

```{r func_mem_score}
clean_score <- function(x) {
  hcap_missing_codes <- c(96, 97, 98, 99, 996, 997, 998, 999)

  x <- haven::zap_missing(x)
  x <- haven::zap_labels(x)
  x <- as.numeric(x)

  x[x %in% hcap_missing_codes] <- NA_real_

  x
}

# Set scores whose imputation flag is 1 to missing
drop_imputed_scores <- function(score, flag) {
  flag <- clean_score(flag)
  ifelse(!is.na(flag) & flag == 1, NA_real_, score)
}

extract_oshea_scores <- function(
    hcap, oshea_var_df, use_imputed_scores = TRUE
) {
  oshea_raw <- hcap %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "HHID",
      "PN",
      dplyr::all_of(oshea_var_df$hcap_var),
      dplyr::all_of(stats::na.omit(oshea_var_df$imp_flag))
    )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(oshea_var_df))) {
    old <- oshea_var_df$hcap_var[i]
    new <- oshea_var_df$component_name[i]
    oshea_raw[[new]] <- clean_score(oshea_raw[[old]])

    # Apply the same imputation rule used for the Sutin components.
    if (!use_imputed_scores && !is.na(oshea_var_df$imp_flag[i])) {
      oshea_raw[[new]] <- drop_imputed_scores(
        oshea_raw[[new]], oshea_raw[[oshea_var_df$imp_flag[i]]]
      )
    }
  }

  # Match the published O'Shea recoding used in the original program.
  oshea_raw$oshea_three_word_delayed <- dplyr::case_when(
    oshea_raw$oshea_three_word_delayed <= 1 ~ 0,
    oshea_raw$oshea_three_word_delayed == 2 ~ 1,
    oshea_raw$oshea_three_word_delayed == 3 ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )

  oshea_raw %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "HHID",
      "PN",
      dplyr::all_of(oshea_var_df$component_name)
    )
}

extract_memory_score <- function(hcap, memory_var_df) {
  memory_raw <- hcap %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "HHID",
      "PN",
      dplyr::all_of(memory_var_df$hcap_var),
      dplyr::all_of(stats::na.omit(memory_var_df$imp_flag))
    )

  ## Rename HCAP score variables to readable names
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(memory_var_df))) {
    old <- memory_var_df$hcap_var[i]
    new <- memory_var_df$score_name[i]
    memory_raw[[new]] <- clean_score(memory_raw[[old]])
  }

  memory_raw
}

check_imputed_scores <- function(
    memory_raw, memory_var_df, use_imputed_scores = TRUE
) {
  if (!use_imputed_scores) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(memory_var_df))) {
      score_name <- memory_var_df$score_name[i]
      flag_var <- memory_var_df$imp_flag[i]

      if (!is.na(flag_var)) {
        memory_raw[[score_name]] <- drop_imputed_scores(
          memory_raw[[score_name]], memory_raw[[flag_var]]
        )
      }
    }
  }

  ## Keep only ID + readable memory task variables
  memory_raw <- memory_raw %>%
    dplyr::select("HHID", "PN", dplyr::all_of(memory_var_df$score_name))

  memory_raw
}

get_memory_scores <- function(hcap, memory_var_df, use_imputed_scores = TRUE) {
  memory_raw <- extract_memory_score(hcap, memory_var_df)
  memory_raw <- check_imputed_scores(
    memory_raw, memory_var_df, use_imputed_scores = use_imputed_scores
  )

  memory_raw
}

check_memory_ranges <- function(memory_var_df, memory_raw) {
  range_check <- memory_var_df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(memory_raw[[score_name]])),
      n_missing = sum(is.na(memory_raw[[score_name]])),
      observed_min = suppressWarnings(min(memory_raw[[score_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      observed_max = suppressWarnings(max(memory_raw[[score_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      n_out_of_range = sum(
        !is.na(memory_raw[[score_name]]) &
          (memory_raw[[score_name]] < expected_min |
             memory_raw[[score_name]] > expected_max)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "score_name",
      "hcap_var",
      "expected_min",
      "expected_max",
      "observed_min",
      "observed_max",
      "n_nonmissing",
      "n_missing",
      "n_out_of_range"
    )

  range_check
}

stop_if_out_of_range <- function(range_check) {
  stop_if_any(
    range_check$score_name[range_check$n_out_of_range > 0],
    "The scores ",
    " had values outside of the expected range."
  )
}
```

## Compute Composite Score

```{r func_composite}
get_oshea_ref <- function(oshea_raw, oshea_var_df) {
  component_vars <- oshea_var_df$component_name

  ref_df <- tibble::tibble(
    component_name = component_vars,
    sample_size = colSums(!is.na(oshea_raw[, component_vars])),
    mean_ref = colMeans(oshea_raw[, component_vars], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ref = apply(oshea_raw[, component_vars], 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  ref_df
}

validate_oshea_ref <- function(reference_oshea, oshea_var_df) {
  stop_if_any(
    setdiff(c("component_name", "mean_ref", "sd_ref"), names(reference_oshea)),
    "`reference_oshea` is missing column(s): "
  )

  dupes <- reference_oshea$component_name[
    duplicated(reference_oshea$component_name)
  ]
  stop_if_any(
    unique(dupes),
    "`reference_oshea` has duplicated component_name(s): "
  )

  stop_if_any(
    setdiff(oshea_var_df$component_name, reference_oshea$component_name),
    "`reference_oshea` has no mean/SD for: "
  )

  ref_used <- reference_oshea[
    match(oshea_var_df$component_name, reference_oshea$component_name),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  stop_if_any(
    ref_used$component_name[is.na(ref_used$sd_ref) | ref_used$sd_ref <= 0],
    "`reference_oshea` has a missing or non-positive SD for: "
  )

  invisible(reference_oshea)
}

standardize_oshea <- function(
    oshea_raw,
    ref_df,
    oshea_var_df,
    min_tasks_required = 5
) {
  component_vars <- oshea_var_df$component_name
  ref_used <- ref_df[
    match(component_vars, ref_df$component_name),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  oshea_scaled <- oshea_raw[, component_vars]
  oshea_scaled <- sweep(oshea_scaled, 2, ref_used$mean_ref, FUN = "-")
  oshea_scaled <- sweep(oshea_scaled, 2, ref_used$sd_ref, FUN = "/")

  z_vars <- paste0(component_vars, "_z")
  colnames(oshea_scaled) <- z_vars

  oshea_scores <- dplyr::bind_cols(oshea_raw, oshea_scaled) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_oshea_items = rowSums(
        !is.na(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(z_vars)))
      ),
      .oshea_mean = rowMeans(
        dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(z_vars)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      OSHEA_MEM = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$n_oshea_items >= min_tasks_required,
        .data$.oshea_mean,
        NA_real_
      ),
      OSHEA_MEM_ALL6 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$n_oshea_items == length(z_vars),
        .data$.oshea_mean,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-".oshea_mean")

  oshea_scores
}

get_memory_dist <- function(memory_raw, memory_var_df) {
  memory_stat_df <- memory_raw %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(memory_var_df$score_name),
        list(
          sample_size = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
          ave = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          std = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      dplyr::everything(),
      names_to = c("score_name", ".value"),
      names_sep = "_(?=sample_size$|ave$|std$)"
    )

  memory_stat_df
}

standardize_memory <- function(memory_raw, memory_var_df, memory_stat_df) {
  memory_z <- memory_raw %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(memory_var_df$score_name),
        function(x) {
          idx <- match(dplyr::cur_column(), memory_stat_df$score_name)
          (x - memory_stat_df$ave[idx]) / memory_stat_df$std[idx]
        },
        .names = "{.col}_z"
      )
    )

  memory_z
}

compute_composite_scores <- function(
    memory_z, memory_var_df, min_tasks_required = 7
) {
  z_vars <- paste0(memory_var_df$score_name, "_z")
  cerad_z_vars <- paste0(
    memory_var_df$score_name[grepl("^cerad_", memory_var_df$score_name)],
    "_z"
  )

  memory_scores <- memory_z %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_memory_tasks = rowSums(
        !is.na(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(z_vars)))
      ),
      n_cerad_tasks = rowSums(
        !is.na(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cerad_z_vars)))
      ),
      .sutin_mean = base::rowMeans(
        dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(z_vars)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      SUT_MEM = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$n_memory_tasks >= min_tasks_required,
        .data$.sutin_mean,
        NA_real_
      ),
      SUT_MEM_ALL8 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$n_memory_tasks == length(z_vars),
        .data$.sutin_mean,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .cerad_mean = base::rowMeans(
        dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cerad_z_vars)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      # CERAD-only sensitivity score avoids tests whose administration mode
      # differed between the two HCAP waves. Require all three CERAD tasks.
      SUT_MEM_CERAD3 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$n_cerad_tasks == length(cerad_z_vars),
        .data$.cerad_mean,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "HHID",
      "PN",
      dplyr::all_of(memory_var_df$score_name),
      dplyr::all_of(z_vars),
      "n_memory_tasks",
      "n_cerad_tasks",
      "SUT_MEM",
      "SUT_MEM_ALL8",
      "SUT_MEM_CERAD3"
    )

  memory_scores
}

add_composite_scores <- function(
    hcap, memory_var_df, memory_raw, memory_stat_df, min_tasks_required = 7
) {
  memory_z <- standardize_memory(memory_raw, memory_var_df, memory_stat_df)
  memory_scores <- compute_composite_scores(
    memory_z, memory_var_df, min_tasks_required = min_tasks_required
  )

  hcap <- hcap %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      memory_scores,
      by = c("HHID", "PN"),
      relationship = "one-to-one",
      na_matches = "never"
    )

  hcap
}
```

## Wrapper Function

```{r func_wrapper}
validate_reference_stats <- function(reference_stats, memory_var_df) {
  stop_if_any(
    setdiff(c("score_name", "ave", "std"), names(reference_stats)),
    "`reference_stats` is missing column(s): "
  )

  dupes <- reference_stats$score_name[duplicated(reference_stats$score_name)]
  stop_if_any(
    unique(dupes),
    "`reference_stats` has duplicated score_name(s): ",
    ". `match()` would silently use only the first."
  )

  stop_if_any(
    setdiff(memory_var_df$score_name, reference_stats$score_name),
    "`reference_stats` has no mean/SD for: ",
    ". Standardization would silently return NA for these tasks."
  )

  ref_used <- reference_stats[
    reference_stats$score_name %in% memory_var_df$score_name,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  stop_if_any(
    ref_used$score_name[is.na(ref_used$std) | ref_used$std <= 0],
    "`reference_stats` has a missing or non-positive SD for: "
  )

  invisible(reference_stats)
}

process_hcap_wave <- function(
    version = c("16", "22"),
    test_num = c("R1", "R2"),
    has_imp = TRUE,
    use_imputed_scores = TRUE,
    reference_stats = NULL,
    reference_oshea = NULL,
    min_tasks_required = 7,
    min_oshea_tasks_required = 5,
    save_dir = "."
) {
  version <- as.character(version)
  version <- match.arg(version)
  test_num <- match.arg(test_num)

  hcap <- get_hcap_data(version = version)

  memory_var_df <- get_memory_variables(
    hcap,
    has_imp = has_imp,
    test_num = test_num
  )

  memory_raw <- get_memory_scores(
    hcap,
    memory_var_df,
    use_imputed_scores = use_imputed_scores
  )

  write.csv(
    memory_raw,
    file = file.path(save_dir, paste0("hc", version, "_memory.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  range_check <- check_memory_ranges(memory_var_df, memory_raw)

  if (is.null(reference_stats)) {
    memory_stat_df <- get_memory_dist(memory_raw, memory_var_df)
    validate_reference_stats(memory_stat_df, memory_var_df)
    reference_source <- "self"
  } else {
    validate_reference_stats(reference_stats, memory_var_df)
    memory_stat_df <- reference_stats
    reference_source <- "external"
  }

  hcap <- add_composite_scores(
    hcap,
    memory_var_df,
    memory_raw,
    memory_stat_df,
    min_tasks_required = min_tasks_required
  )

  oshea_var_df <- get_oshea_memory_variables(
    hcap,
    has_imp = has_imp,
    test_num = test_num
  )
  oshea_raw <- extract_oshea_scores(
    hcap,
    oshea_var_df,
    use_imputed_scores = use_imputed_scores
  )

  if (is.null(reference_oshea)) {
    oshea_stat_df <- get_oshea_ref(oshea_raw, oshea_var_df)
    validate_oshea_ref(oshea_stat_df, oshea_var_df)
    oshea_source <- "self"
  } else {
    validate_oshea_ref(reference_oshea, oshea_var_df)
    oshea_stat_df <- reference_oshea
    oshea_source <- "external"
  }

  oshea_scores <- standardize_oshea(
    oshea_raw,
    oshea_stat_df,
    oshea_var_df,
    min_tasks_required = min_oshea_tasks_required
  )
  hcap <- hcap %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      oshea_scores,
      by = c("HHID", "PN"),
      relationship = "one-to-one",
      na_matches = "never"
    )

  interview_year <- paste0(test_num, "IWYEAR")
  interview_month <- paste0(test_num, "IWMONTH")
  subject_score_vars <- c(
    memory_var_df$score_name,
    paste0(memory_var_df$score_name, "_z"),
    "n_memory_tasks",
    "n_cerad_tasks",
    "SUT_MEM",
    "SUT_MEM_ALL8",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3",
    oshea_var_df$component_name,
    paste0(oshea_var_df$component_name, "_z"),
    "n_oshea_items",
    "OSHEA_MEM",
    "OSHEA_MEM_ALL6"
  )
  subject_scores <- hcap %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      HHID = .data$HHID,
      PN = .data$PN,
      INTERVIEW_YEAR = .data[[interview_year]],
      INTERVIEW_MONTH = .data[[interview_month]],
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(subject_score_vars))
    )

  list(
    hcap               = hcap,
    memory_raw         = memory_raw,
    memory_stat_df     = memory_stat_df,
    memory_var_df      = memory_var_df,
    oshea_stat_df      = oshea_stat_df,
    oshea_var_df       = oshea_var_df,
    oshea_raw          = oshea_raw,
    subject_scores     = subject_scores,
    range_check        = range_check,
    reference_source   = reference_source,
    oshea_source       = oshea_source,
    has_imp            = has_imp,
    use_imputed_scores = use_imputed_scores
  )
}
```

# Calculate HC16 Composite Score

## Calculate

```{r calc_hcap16}
hc16 <- process_hcap_wave(
  version = 16,
  test_num = "R1",
  has_imp = TRUE,
  # HC22 has no imputed values. For the sake of consistency, we remove them
  # from HC16 as well
  use_imputed_scores = FALSE,
  reference_stats = NULL,
  reference_oshea = NULL,
  min_tasks_required = 7,
  min_oshea_tasks_required = 5,
  save_dir = data_dir
)
```

## Check Distributions

```{r check_hcap16}
hc16$range_check
table(hc16$hcap$n_memory_tasks)
table(hc16$hcap$n_oshea_items)

stop_if_out_of_range(hc16$range_check)
```

## Save Memory Scaling Reference

```{r save_ref}
write.csv(
  hc16$memory_stat_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "hc16_reference_stats.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  hc16$oshea_stat_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "hc16_oshea_reference_stats.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Calculate HC22 Composite Score

## Calculate

```{r calc_hcap22}
hc22 <- process_hcap_wave(
  version = 22,
  test_num = "R2",
  has_imp = FALSE,
  # HC22 has no imputation flags, so we don't use them.
  use_imputed_scores = FALSE,
  reference_stats = hc16$memory_stat_df,
  reference_oshea = hc16$oshea_stat_df,
  min_tasks_required = 7,
  min_oshea_tasks_required = 5,
  save_dir = data_dir
)
stopifnot(
  hc22$reference_source == "external",
  hc22$oshea_source == "external"
)
```
